sentences.text:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CORAM : SMT. URMILA JOSHI PHALKE, J.

DATE : 08.08.2024  Apprehending the arrest at the hands of  police in connection with Crime No.363/2024  registered with Police Station Allipur, District -  Wardha, for the offence punishable under Sections  275, 274, 223, 123 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita  and Section 3(1)(zz)(iv), 30(2)(a), 27(3)(e) and 26(2)(iv) and 26(1) of the Food Safety and  Standards Act, 2006, the applicant approached to  this Court for grant of pre-arrest bail.
 2. The applicant is apprehending arrest at  the hands of police as crime is registered, on the  basis of report lodged by Rajesh B. Yadav, Food  Inspector, on an allegation that, he received the  information regarding selling of contraband i.e.
Prity  2/3 14.aba577.2024  scented nuts and scented tobacco.
Therefore, he  conducted the raid and the applicant was found in  possession and transporting the contraband.
On the  basis of the said, crime was registered against the  present applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant  submitted that as far as the custodial interrogation is  concerned, which is not required, as the entire stock  is already recovered.

He submitted that merely on Murlidhar S/O Bacchumal Sachdev vs State Of Mah. Thr. Pso Allipur Wardha on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193846599/
1  the suspicion ground, crime is registered against the  present applicant, he is ready to co-operate with the  investigating agency, in view of that, he be protected  by granting ad-interim protection.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned APP strongly opposed the said  application on the ground that the prohibited  contraband articles are found in possession of the  present applicant, his custodial interrogation is  required.
In view of that, prayer for grant of ad-  interim protection deserves to be rejected.

5. After hearing the learned counsel for the  applicant and learned APP for the State, perused the  recitals of the FIR, it reveals that the entire  contraband is already seized and in the possession of  the present applicant, as far as the interrogation part  is present, which can be taken care of by imposing Prity  3/3 14.aba577  certain conditions, in view of that, the prayer fo  grant of ad-interim protection deserves to be  allowed.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the follow  order : -
 ORDER (a) In the event of the arrest in connection with Crime No.363/2024 registered with Police Station Allipur, District - Wardha, for the offence punishable under Sections 275, 274, 223, 123 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Section 3(1)(zz)(iv), 30(2)(a), 27(3)(e) and 26(2)(iv) and 26(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the applicant Murlidhar s/o Bacchumal Sachdev shall be released on ad- interim anticipatory bail on executing PR bond of Rs.25,000/- with one surety in the like amount.
( b) The applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station once in a week on Sunday between 10:00 a.m. between 1:00 p.m. and shall co-operate with the investigating agency.

(c) The applicant shall not induce, threat or promise any witnesses who are acquainted with the facts of the case.
6. Stand over after two weeks.
(SMT. URMILA JOSHI PHALKE, J) Signed by: Mrs. PrityPrity Gabhane Designation: PA To Honourable Judge Date: 08/08/2024 19:09:43 Murlidhar S/O Bacchumal Sachdev vs State Of Mah. Thr. Pso Allipur Wardha on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193846599/
